items.title: 21.3.2 Beta-Elimination Reactions (β-H aur halogen ka nikalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.3.2, printed pages 78-79.

blocks.text: β-elimination woh reaction hai jis mein alkyl halide ke β-carbon (halogen wale carbon ke bilkul saath wala carbon) par laga hydrogen atom aur saath wale carbon par laga halogen atom, dono halogenoalkane se nikal jate hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab base halogenoalkane ke β-hydrogen par attack kare. Halogen ya to usi waqt (simultaneously) nikalta hai ya hydrogen ke nikalne ke baad. Is tarah substitution product ki bajaye alkene ka molecule milta hai. Yeh reactions substitution reactions ke saath saath hote hain aur aksar un se compete (muqabla) karte hain. Nucleophilic substitution ki tarah elimination bhi do mechanisms se ho sakta hai: E2 ya E1.

E2 mechanism mein base β-hydrogen par attack karta hai aur usi waqt leaving group nikal jata hai, aur carbon-carbon double bond ban jata hai. Single step (ek qadam) wala E2 mechanism neeche diya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Base- se bromoethane ke beta H ki taraf curly arrow, us C-H bond se C-C bond ki taraf curly arrow, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf curly arrow; result: ethene + H-Base + Br-.
blocks.caption: E2 mechanism: bromoethane (kitab ke PDF page 81 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki E2 drawing mein C–Br bond se Br tak ka curly arrow (mura hua teer) nahi chhapa. Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikalta hai, is liye hamari drawing mein yeh arrow add kiya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Base β-carbon ka H kheenchta hai; us C–H bond ke electrons do carbons ke darmiyan doosra bond (C=C) banate hain; aur isi waqt Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikal jata hai. Teeno kaam ek hi step mein hote hain.

E2 reaction bimolecular hai aur is ka rate (speed) alkyl halide aur base, dono ki concentrations par depend karta hai. SN2 ki tarah E2 ki molecularity (step mein hissa lene wale molecules ki ginti) bhi do hai, aur yeh second order kinetics dikhate hain.

E1 mechanism mein, SN1 ki tarah, pehla step substrate ka slow (sust) ionization hai jis se carbocation banta hai. Doosre step mein base β-hydrogen par attack karta hai aur product ke taur par alkene banti hai.

blocks.alt: Step 1: 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (C par delta+, Br par delta-) equilibrium arrowon (slow) se 3 darje (tertiary) ka carbocation + Br- deta hai. Step 2: Base- se beta H ki taraf curly arrow, aur us C-H bond se positive carbon wale bond ki taraf curly arrow, fast (tez), 2-methylpropene + H-Base.
blocks.caption: E1 mechanism: 2-bromo-2-methylpropane (kitab ke PDF page 81 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki E1 drawing (Step 1) mein carbocation ke ek methyl group ko 'CH₂' likha gaya hai. Sahi CH₃ hai, kyun ke carbocation (CH₃)₃C⁺ ke teeno groups CH₃ hain, jaisa hamari drawing mein hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step 1 mein Br⁻ slow (dheere) nikalta hai aur 3° (tertiary) carbocation banta hai. Step 2 mein base β-carbon ka H hatata hai aur C–H ke electrons positive carbon ki taraf ja kar C=C banate hain; 2-methylpropene milti hai.

E1 unimolecular mechanism hai; is ka rate sirf alkyl halide ki concentration par depend karta hai. Primary halogenoalkanes aam taur par E2 se aur tertiary halogenoalkanes E1 se chalte hain. Secondary halogenoalkanes solvent ki choice (intikhab) ke mutabiq E2 aur E1 dono dikha sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kya 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropane, (CH₃)₃C–CH₂Br, elimination karta hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi: β-carbon, yani C(CH₃)₃, par koi hydrogen nahi, is liye base ke paas hatane ke liye koi β-hydrogen nahi.

items: β-elimination: β-H aur X nikal kar alkene banti hai; substitution ke saath competition (muqabla) hota hai.
E2: ek step, Rate = k[Alkyl halide][Base], second order. E1: carbocation ke zariye, rate sirf alkyl halide par.
Primary: E2; tertiary: E1; secondary: dono (solvent ke mutabiq).
